en.description: Recover a dropped event stream by overlapping live delivery with history and deduplicating by event ID while checking stop conditions independently.
en.scenario: A worker reconnects after a network gap. A history request may include events emitted during the gap while a newly opened live stream is already buffering newer events.
en.mechanism: Open the live stream first, fetch and process available history, then consume the live tail. Gate event side effects on unseen IDs, but evaluate terminal or idle-stop conditions for every live event, including duplicates.
en.bad: Reconnect from now and assume the stream replays the gap, or skip a repeated event with continue before checking whether it marks the session terminal.
en.good: Open the replacement stream, read history and record its IDs, then tail the stream. Ignore duplicate handling while still applying the lifecycle stop check to a repeated terminal event.
en.why: History covers the disconnect interval while the live stream covers events after reconnection; overlap can repeat events. Separate deduplication from lifecycle checks to avoid duplicate side effects without suppressing termination.
en.expected: For history and stream data actually returned, each stable event ID is handled at most once and an observed terminal event can still stop the consumer.
en.boundaries: Confirm history pagination/completeness, retention, ordering, stable IDs and stop semantics for the target API/SDK. This cannot recover events absent from history or establish a delivery guarantee; preserve order if the consumer depends on it.

zh.description: 事件流断线后，用历史记录与新实时流重叠补齐可见区间，按事件ID去重，并独立检查停止条件。
zh.scenario: 任务执行器断网后重连；历史查询可能含有断线期间的事件，新实时流此时也已开始缓冲后续事件。
zh.mechanism: 先打开实时流，再读取并处理可取得的历史记录，最后消费实时尾流。仅让未见过的ID触发副作用；每个实时事件仍要检查终态或空闲停止条件，包括重复事件。
zh.bad: 重连后从“现在”继续并假定流会补发缺口，或遇到重复事件就先 continue，跳过其中的会话终止信号。
zh.good: 先建立新流、再读取历史并记录历史事件ID，随后跟随实时流。重复事件不重复处理，但仍执行生命周期停止检查。
zh.why: 历史覆盖断线区间，实时流覆盖重连之后；两者重叠会产生重复。将副作用去重与生命周期判断分开，才能避免重复操作又不漏掉结束状态。
zh.expected: 对于接口实际返回的历史与流，在事件ID稳定时每个ID最多处理一次；已观察到的终止事件仍能结束消费。
zh.boundaries: 需核实目标API/SDK的历史分页完整性、保留期、排序、ID稳定性及停止语义。历史中不存在的事件无法由此恢复，也不能据此保证投递；若消费端依赖顺序，应保留顺序。
